description: This file contains functions and types related to normalizing and resolving matrix allowlist entries, including user ID normalization, allowlist entry normalization, and matching logic.

methods.name: normalizeAllowList
methods.description: Normalizes a list of allowlist entries by applying string normalization.

methods.name: normalizeMatrixUser
methods.description: Normalizes a raw matrix user string, handling '@' and ':' delimiters.

methods.name: normalizeMatrixUserId
methods.description: Normalizes a user ID string, handling 'matrix:' and 'user:' prefixes.

methods.name: normalizeMatrixAllowListEntry
methods.description: Normalizes a single allowlist entry, handling wildcards and prefixes.

methods.name: normalizeMatrixAllowList
methods.description: Normalizes an array of allowlist entries.

methods.name: resolveMatrixAllowListMatch
methods.description: Resolves whether a user ID matches an allowlist, returning match details.

methods.name: resolveMatrixAllowListMatches
methods.description: Checks if a user ID is allowed based on the allowlist.
